items.title: Kenny Barron — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: There’s a record, for instance, a duo record I did with Mino Cinelu, called Swamp Sally.

ctx.x: Are there any others that maybe figure – that you would consider also very important? Or that you consider very enjoyable?

Yeah, actually. There’s a record, for instance, a duo record I did with Mino Cinelu, called Swamp Sally. That was unusual, because it was the first time I had ever done a recording using a lot of electronics. I even played acoustic bass.
Ooo – going back to your roots.
